title: Compact-support functor congruence for equal morphisms
statement: Let A be a commutative ring of universe u+1, X,Y schemes of universe u [def-pc-scheme], f,f′:X→Y compactifiable morphisms [def-asd-compactifiable], and h:f=f′. In the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-A module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], define unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A h:Rf_!≅Rf′_! [def-amb-etale-compact-support] by equality elimination on h, with reflexive case the identity natural isomorphism. The two HasCompactification witnesses are propositions. This is the specified congruence of the actual functors, not an arbitrarily chosen natural isomorphism and not a base-change or composition theorem.

lean.statement:
def unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : X ⟶ Y}
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f'] (h : f = f') :
    rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅
      rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f'
